verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev supports triggering many task runs programmatically (batch triggering, concurrency controls, queues, retries) which enables bulk operations across items, and its management API/MCP server allows an AI assistant to trigger and monitor many runs. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'batch trigger' API or bulk-item processing pattern, and no hands-on evidence of an AI agent actually orchestrating bulk operations at scale via the MCP/CLI tools. missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk trigger API documentation, evidence of AI-driven bulk operation orchestration, independent confirmation of bulk-scale reliability.
